admission.scope: freeze after pilot, before native sampling; R0 is not a native result
admission.benefit: paired process-block 95% CI wholly below 1 for cold total or absolute RSS on at least one predeclared same-output workload
admission.statistics: 10000 seeded bootstrap resamples of paired process-block median log ratios; at least 10 independent blocks for an admission claim
admission.regression: report every group; >1.20 median cold-time or RSS ratio blocks default replacement; optional backend may retain explicit restricted scope
admission.correctness: all joint outputs, statuses, certificates and independent validators pass; no PH bypass
